title: Autopilot midpoint-relay chain (testkit_autowire PASS B) is never exercised by any test or golden
evidence:
core/testkit.odin: "// span defeats the direct link: drop a relay at the midpoint; it is
		// itself an island and chains one hop per tick toward the network
		rt, ok := best_router_in_stock(state)
		if !ok { continue }
		hub_slot := t.node_by_id[hub]
		mid := (t.node_pos[i] + t.node_pos[hub_slot]) / 2
		place_near(state, submit, mid, rt, tick)". Instrumented probe of the exact covered runs (seed 42, 3100 ticks = surge_basics/test_full_surge_win; seed 42, 600 ticks = determinism keystone; seeds 99/100, 300 ticks): "seed=42 ticks=3100: placed=1 relayCandidates=0 won=true lost=false" and "seed=42 ticks=600: placed=0 relayCandidates=0". The only placement (apply_tick 801, router_mid, nearestResidSq=2) is PASS-A house-adjacent; the blessed surge_basics.log.bin carries exactly one tag-7 record.
detail: The relay branch is new in this diff and fires in no test, demo, or golden run (probe-verified: 0 midpoint placements across every autopilot-covered seed). A defect there is invisible to CI.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test or demo that forces the relay path (island router beyond wide max_span 18 from every reachable hub) and asserts the placement + mesh.

title: Grants landing and Ev_Stock_Arrived have no direct assertion — only the opaque surge_basics T1 golden pins them
evidence: core/run.odin: "// 1b. hardware deliveries (grants): deterministic by tick, before growth —\n...\n\t\t\temit(state, tick, Ev_Stock_Arrived{links = nl, routers = nr})". core/events.odin:36: "Ev_Stock_Arrived :: struct { links: i32, routers: i32 }". grep -rn 'Stock_Arrived|grants|grant' core/*_test.odin harness/ demos/ app/run/*.odin returned zero matches. data/balance.json grants at at_tick 600/1200/1800/2400 all fall inside surge_basics (run 310000ms @ 10Hz = 3100 ticks), so only the per-tick T1 hash (serialize.odin:210 tag 14 + inventory counts) covers them; no demo uses 'expect event stock_arrived'.
detail: Priority coverage question (1) grants + (5) event assertions: neither the inventory increment nor the event content is asserted directly anywhere; a regression survives unless the golden is regenerated without scrutiny.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test that steps to a grant tick and asserts inventory deltas (e.g. links[standard] +2 at tick 600) plus one Ev_Stock_Arrived{links=3} event.

title: Action-log codec tag 4 (Cmd_Set_Lane_Weights) is never written or read by any test, demo, or blessed log
evidence: core/serialize.odin:243: "w_u8(&w, 4); w_u32(&w, c.pipe)" and 327: "case 4:". Byte-level parse of all 7 blessed logs: "surge_basics.log.bin n=16 tags=[(1, 14), (5, 1), (7, 1)]", "qos_dial.log.bin n=9 tags=[(1, 6), (5, 2), (6, 1)]", "draw_and_upgrade.log.bin n=6 tags=[(1, 3), (2, 1), (3, 2)]" — tag 4 absent from every log. determinism_test.odin round-trip switch covers only "case Cmd_Draw_Pipe:" and "case Cmd_Set_Pipe_Priority:". No demo verb emits lane weights and app/main.odin never builds Cmd_Set_Lane_Weights.
detail: The ODN-11 binary round-trip pin covers 2 of 7 tags in the unit test; tag 4 has zero write/read execution anywhere, so a field-order or width bug in that codec branch passes every gate.
recommended_fix: Extend test_action_log_binary_roundtrip to submit Cmd_Set_Lane_Weights (via testkit or a direct log-build) and compare fields after log_read.

title: catalogs_load fail-fast validation branches have no negative tests — all 43 tests exercise only the happy path
location: core/catalog.odin:catalogs_load (patch hunk, ~200 lines of validation branches)
evidence: core/catalog.odin: "if b.breach_exit_pct < b.win_uptime_pct || b.breach_exit_pct > 100 {\n\t\t\treturn cat, {"balance.json", "breach_exit_pct", "must be >= win_uptime_pct and <= 100 (E30 hysteresis)}"" and "if _, ok := node_type_index(cat, "content_host"); !ok {\n\t\treturn cat, {"node_types.json", "content_host", "PROTO requires the content_host type"}". Every test loads via catalogs_testkit.odin: "src.packet_types = #load("../data/packet_types.json") ... return catalogs_load(&src)" or a benign patch (patch_balance_cap swaps packet_pool_cap 6000->24, still valid). No test feeds malformed/unknown-class/non-ascending-grant/out-of-range input; `odin test core` reports "Finished 43 tests ... All tests were successful".
detail: A 200+ branch validator with zero negative tests: a validation bug (accepting a bad catalog or rejecting a good one) is caught only by manual startup, never by CI.
recommended_fix: Add table-driven negative load tests: unknown class_id/tier/grant name, non-ascending grants, breach_exit<win_uptime, empty entries, truncated JSON — each asserting the named Catalog_Error.

title: Ev_Warning_Raised emission is never asserted — node-health test pins transitions and Warning_Cleared only
evidence: core/flow_edge_test.odin: "// recovery: load clears -> Healthy, and a Warning_Cleared event fires" and "if _, ok := e.kind.(Ev_Warning_Cleared); ok { saw_clear = true }\n...\n\tif !saw_clear { tfail(t, "recovery must emit Warning_Cleared") }". grep -rn 'Warning_Raised' core/*_test.odin returns no matches (only harness/demo_parse.odin:329 and app/main.odin:436 reference it). The raise branch (crisis.odin emits Ev_Warning_Raised{node, level} on Strained/Critical transitions) is covered only by the opaque T1 hash of surge_basics.
detail: The r2 node-health test is a real pin for state transitions and the cleared event, but the raised event (with level) that the HUD warning surface depends on has no direct assertion.
recommended_fix: In test_node_health_states_transition_under_load, assert Ev_Warning_Raised fires with level .Critical then .Strained on the transitions (events were cleared before each evaluate).

title: No demo exercises place_router through the bus — the demo verb exists but zero demos use it
evidence: harness/demo_parse.odin: "case "place_router":\n\t\tif len(fields) < 4 { return it, fmt.tprintf("line %d: place_router type x y", ln) }" and intent_command: "cmd.kind = pp.Cmd_Place_Router{type_idx = ti, pos = {i32(it.x), i32(it.y)}}". All 7 demos (boot, draw_and_reject, draw_and_upgrade, error404, flow_basics, qos_dial, surge_basics) contain no place_router intent. Core-path E2E exists only via the autopilot (one tag-7 record in surge_basics.log.bin); the bus path used by the app UI (app/main.odin:249-280) is CI-unexercised for this command.
detail: Cmd_Place_Router's core validation/consume path is well covered, but the player-path E2E (intent through bus_submit with Out_Of_Routers/Invalid_Placement errors) has no scripted demo pin.
recommended_fix: Add a small demo (e.g. place_router router_mid 30 6 -> ok, an off-map -> invalid_placement, and an empty-shelf -> out_of_routers) with expects and a capture.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: P0 determinism spine is 100% (rng pinned vectors, packet-rich 600-tick replay keystone, replay gate on all 7 blessed logs, T2 software-rendered goldens — `odin test core`: 43/43 green; Perkins-verified 7/7 demos + 3000/3000 replay). P1 direct-assertion coverage ≈ 82%: inventory consume/return/exchange/Out_Of_Links/Out_Of_Routers/placement-validation, QoS allocate/gap-fill, E1/E22/E26/E27/E28/E30/E31, health grace/drain/win/lose/terminal, growth determinism, queue-overflow shedding and node-health transitions are all directly pinned; shortfalls: grants + Ev_Stock_Arrived (golden-only), place_router bus E2E (no demo), autopilot relay chain (never fired), tag-4 codec (never round-tripped), catalog negative validation (none), Ev_Warning_Raised (unasserted).
detail: P0 100% and every core-loop behaviour has a direct pin, but six new-r2 surfaces rely on opaque goldens or are unexercised; goldens are not substitute direct assertions for the harness's own new features.
recommended_fix: Close the three cheapest gaps to reach PASS: a grant-tick unit test (inventory deltas + Ev_Stock_Arrived), a place_router demo intent set, and a relay-chain scenario pin; optionally assert Ev_Warning_Raised in the node-health test.
